summary: Frontend-only verification of the presenter cutout crop fix on the persistent floating player. All 6 requested checks passed on both mobile (390x844) and desktop (1920x1080). The current live show now has presenter.image, so the cutout element renders and could be measured live (unlike previous iteration).
critical_code_review_comments: PersistentPlayer.jsx correctly uses object-contain + object-bottom on the presenter and overflow-visible with -inset-x-3 md:-inset-x-4 on the cutout container. Aspect ratio preserved, no cropping.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Base URL https://blend-launch.preview.emergentagent.com. isShowView toggles every 7s, wait >=8s after scroll for cutout opacity to reach 1. Measurements confirmed: mobile cutout 80x108 (slot 56+24 wider), pokes 36px above card; desktop cutout 112x132 (slot 80+32 wider), pokes 32px above card. object-fit=contain, object-position=50% 100%, overflow=visible on both. Mobile rings: 5 .blend-ring-flash, mixBlendMode=normal, borderColor rgba(255,255,255,0.38), .blend-sphere width=340. scrollWidth==innerWidth on both viewports (no horizontal overflow).
